recognize_zh: 高倍胸水抹片中，大型細胞具不規則或腎形/分葉狀核、細緻染色質與明顯核仁，灰藍色細胞質含多個小空泡，旁邊的小淋巴球大小約只有它們的三分之一，符合大型 B 細胞淋巴瘤細胞。
features: Large lymphoid cells about 3 times the diameter of adjacent small lymphocytes
Irregular, indented, folded or multilobated nuclei
Fine to vesicular chromatin with one or more distinct nucleoli
Moderate grey-blue cytoplasm containing numerous small clear vacuoles and cytoplasmic blebs
Background small lymphocytes and crenated red cells
describe_en: Pleural fluid cytospin at high power shows discohesive large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, indented to multilobated nuclei, vesicular chromatin and distinct nucleoli. The cytoplasm is moderate, grey-blue and contains multiple small vacuoles. Scattered small mature lymphocytes are present for comparison, and no cohesive epithelial groups are seen. Findings are consistent with a large B-cell lymphoma involving the pleural fluid, pending immunophenotypic confirmation.

ddx.vs: Macrophages have lower N:C ratio, abundant foamy cytoplasm with phagocytosed material and bland nuclei without prominent nucleoli; CD163/CD68 versus CD20 separates them.
PEL is HHV8-positive and usually lacks CD20 and surface immunoglobulin, often in immunocompromised patients.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized and uniform with round nuclei, multiple small nucleoli and deeply basophilic cytoplasm, not large pleomorphic lobated nuclei.
Mesothelial cells show central round nuclei, dense two-toned cytoplasm and intercellular windows, and are calretinin/keratin-positive.
